_doc: MCP server registry of record (cross-harness migration D9, 2026-08-10). Env vars are NAMES only -- never literals (validate.py rejects '@' or path-like literal env values). Generators (.agents/scripts/gen-mcp-configs.py) REFUSE to emit any write_surface=present server into a harness config without a proven per-tool filter; omission, not scanning, is the control. scope: project = safe to commit into every clone (.mcp.json); user = stays in per-user config only.
provenance: phase1-mcp-index-tests.md (opus worker, 2026-08-10) + live Claude session surface 2026-08-10 (robinhood 54 = 34 read + 20 mutator; claudewatch 32). SUPERSEDED for robinhood-trading on 2026-09-21 by a full harness-listing re-count with no broker call: 61 tools = 51 read + 10 write; see that server's canary field. The claudewatch figure of 32 still matches (31 read + set_session_project).

openinsider.notes: Auth-free, zero local state. Designated conformance server (S5).

vault-search.notes: Hand-rolled JSON-RPC 2.0; needs the local 40MB HNSW index (machine-bound, stale-by-design per the 2026-07-12 idle-gate). CLI alternatives documented in AGENTS.md (D10).

env.EDGAR_IDENTITY: REQUIRED-FROM-ENVIRONMENT (SEC User-Agent courtesy string; PII moved out of committed configs 2026-08-10 per D9)

edgar-tools.notes: 13 read tools per phase1 audit; roster names unverified (server not connected in the audit session). Canary enumerates and pins the roster at first live connection. BROKEN as committed (verified 2026-09-21, audit defect D24): the pinned uvx entry point crashes at import with AttributeError 'Server' object has no attribute 'list_tools', and the harness reports CONNECTION_CLOSED for this server at every session start, so no roster has ever been pinned and the subagents that declare mcp__edgar-tools__* cannot use it. Evidence: _audit/evidence/E12-mcp-handshake-edgar-tools.txt.

env.FRED_API_KEY: REQUIRED-FROM-ENVIRONMENT (launcher falls back to HKCU registry query)

fred.notes: Keyed + local launcher shim -- stays user-scope (never committed into clones).

env.RH_MCP_TOKEN: OPTIONAL non-interactive fallback token env var name (Codex bearer_token_env_var)

tool_filter.claude: proven (permissions.deny 20 mutators + pretrade-token-gate hook; deny extended with the 2 exercise tools 2026-08-10)
tool_filter.codex: unproven-pending-live-probe (M2: enabled_tools allowlist exists in codex-rs source but repo config was authored against the 45-tool surface; probe after auth at S5)

robinhood-trading.canary: full-surface re-verification 2026-09-21 from the harness tool listing, no broker call: 61 tools = 51 read + 10 write (8 state-changing + 2 order-construction). The 2026-08-10 figure of 54 = 34 read + 20 mutator was the previous surface; those 20 names are kept in legacy_write_tools_not_on_the_live_surface and stay denied, because a name the connector drops can come back. Re-verify at any sighting of an unlisted mcp__robinhood-trading__* name.
robinhood-trading.notes: D-SEC-1: order tools mechanically denied Claude-side; EXECUTE ORDER phrase requirement on any write path. Default-refuse: NO harness receives this server generated without a proven filter -- omission stubs instead.
robinhood-trading.enforcement_note: The pre-trade hook's READ allowlist is a hardcoded 34-name subset in tools/pretrade_lib.py. This registry now lists 51 live read tools, so 17 live READ tools are blocked fail-closed by the hook. That is a capability limit, not a safety hole: the hook errs towards blocking. Widening the hook's allowlist to match is proposed in _audit/FIX-PLAN.md and deliberately NOT done as part of the deny-list change, because it would alter what the order gate permits. Verified 2026-09-21 by _audit/evidence/E25-pretrade-hook-probe-2026-09-21.txt: of 61 live names, 34 allow and 27 block, and no write tool is allowed.

tool_filter.claude: n/a (session-metadata write only; never writes inside /path/to/vault)

claudewatch.notes: Semantically Claude-only (reads Claude transcripts/telemetry). Never generated into any non-Claude harness config.
